lines.zh: 翻车鱼侧着身子漂，靠水流推着走
lines.en: I drift on my side, letting the current push.

lines.zh: 河底的石头滚过，翻车鱼慢慢挪
lines.en: River stones roll past as I ease along.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼摆摆尾鳍，转了个笨拙的弯
lines.en: I flap my tail fin into a clumsy turn.

lines.zh: 水面有光，翻车鱼往上游一点点
lines.en: There's light above; I rise a little.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼横着拐弯，圆身子撞到芦苇
lines.en: Turning sideways, my round body hits the reeds.

lines.zh: 河水凉，翻车鱼贴着暖的那层游
lines.en: The river is cold; I swim in the warmer layer.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼把鳍当桨，划两下歇一下
lines.en: Fins as oars, I paddle twice and rest.

lines.zh: 顺着水流走省力，翻车鱼懂这个
lines.en: Going with the current saves strength; I know that.

lines.zh: 河湾水浅，翻车鱼侧身滑过去
lines.en: The bend is shallow, so I slip through sideways.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼游得像块被水推的木板
lines.en: I move like a plank pushed by water.

lines.zh: 芦苇根间有条窄道，翻车鱼钻得进
lines.en: There's a narrow lane in the reeds and I fit.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼掉头很慢，得先停下来
lines.en: I turn slowly, which means stopping first.

lines.zh: 泥底泛起浑水，翻车鱼只顾往前
lines.en: Mud clouds the water; I just keep going.

lines.zh: 河面起风，翻车鱼被吹偏半米
lines.en: Wind ripples the river and pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 我贴着河底滑，肚子蹭到泥。
lines.en: I skim the riverbed, belly brushing mud.

lines.zh: 太阳晒暖水面，我浮上去。
lines.en: The sun warms the surface; I drift up.

lines.zh: 我横着转身，水草全倒了。
lines.en: I turn broadside and the weeds all bend.

lines.zh: 有鱼群经过，我让到一边。
lines.en: A school passes; I move aside.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼浮到水面，摊开身子晒背
lines.en: I float up and spread out to sun my back.

lines.zh: 今天不游了，翻车鱼横在水里发呆
lines.en: Not swimming today; I hang sideways and stare.

lines.zh: 阳光透过河水，暖得像盖了层布
lines.en: Sunlight through the river feels like a warm cloth.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼张着嘴，等水流带吃的来
lines.en: Mouth open, I wait for the current to bring food.

lines.zh: 河底的影子慢慢转，翻车鱼跟着转
lines.en: Shadows on the riverbed turn, and I turn with them.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼打个哈欠，水面冒了个泡
lines.en: I yawn and a bubble pops at the surface.

lines.zh: 圆身子浮着，像一片搁浅的叶子
lines.en: My round body floats like a stranded leaf.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼数浮萍，数着数着就睡了
lines.en: I count duckweed in the current and doze off.

lines.zh: 河水拍岸，翻车鱼听得出神
lines.en: The river laps the bank and I listen, absorbed.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼侧躺休息，鳍还轻轻扇着
lines.en: Lying on my side, fins still fanning softly.

lines.zh: 这条河我熟，哪段静我待哪段
lines.en: I know this river; I keep to the quiet stretch.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼晒够了，翻正身子慢悠悠
lines.en: Sunbaked enough, I roll upright, unhurried.

lines.zh: 水面落了片树叶，翻车鱼看它漂走
lines.en: A leaf falls and I watch it drift away.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼一动不动，装成一截漂木
lines.en: I hold perfectly still, posing as driftwood.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，翻车鱼抬眼看你
lines.en: You stand on the bank and I look up.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼转过来，圆脸对着你
lines.en: I turn my round face toward you.

lines.zh: 你影子落在水面，翻车鱼抬头找
lines.en: Your shadow hits the water and I look up for it.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼盯着你的钓竿看了很久
lines.en: I stare at your fishing rod for a long moment.

lines.zh: 你是来喂鱼的吗，眼神很期待
lines.en: Are you here to feed fish? My eyes are hopeful.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼歪身看你，动作慢半拍
lines.en: I tilt toward you, half a beat behind.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，翻车鱼有点紧张
lines.en: Such a big shadow makes me a little nervous.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼认得岸边那双靴子
lines.en: I recognize those boots on the bank.

lines.zh: 你在河边坐很久，翻车鱼陪你
lines.en: You've sat there long; I'll keep you company.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼眨眼很慢，像在想要不要说话
lines.en: I blink slowly, deciding whether to speak.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼被戳了个洞，疼得乱转
lines.en: Poked through, I spin in pain.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼才三点血，禁不起几下
lines.en: Three hearts only; I can't take many hits.

lines.zh: 圆身子上多了道伤，翻车鱼缩起来
lines.en: A wound on my round body makes me curl.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼躲进水草，喘得很响
lines.en: I hide in the weeds, breathing loudly.

lines.zh: 河水混着血，翻车鱼赶紧游开
lines.en: Blood mixes with river water; I swim away.

lines.zh: 打轻点，翻车鱼连躲都不会
lines.en: Hit softer; I can't even dodge.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼被拍得沉底，又浮上来
lines.en: Slammed to the bottom, I float back up.

lines.zh: 这一下，翻车鱼记你很久
lines.en: That one I'll remember a long time.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼疼得抖，鳍都收不拢
lines.en: I tremble so hard my fins won't close.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼侧躺着，动不了了
lines.en: I lie on my side, unable to move.

lines.zh: 水里有甜味，翻车鱼游过去
lines.en: Something sweet in the water; I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 你把饵丢下河，翻车鱼立刻转向
lines.en: You drop bait in the river and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 这是给我的吗，翻车鱼张开圆嘴
lines.en: Is that for me? I open my round mouth.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼闻到味道，鳍扇得飞快
lines.en: I catch the scent and my fins beat fast.

lines.zh: 河面漂着碎屑，翻车鱼全部收下
lines.en: Scraps drift by and I accept them all.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼跟在你脚边游，等下一口
lines.en: I swim at your feet, waiting for the next bite.

lines.zh: 好吃的东西总在岸边出现
lines.en: Good things always show up near the bank.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼试着咬钩，又松开了
lines.en: I try the hook, then let go.

lines.zh: 再撒一把，翻车鱼就跟你回家
lines.en: Toss one more handful and I'll follow you home.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼肚子响了，比流水还大声
lines.en: My belly growls louder than the river.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼被撞得转圈，圆身子不好停
lines.en: Knocked spinning, my round body won't stop.

lines.zh: 撞我像撞软墙，不疼但很闷
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a soft wall: no pain, just thud.

lines.zh: 芦苇被你撞歪，翻车鱼也歪了
lines.en: You bend the reeds, and I tilt too.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼沉了一下，又慢慢浮起来
lines.en: I sink a little, then slowly float back up.

lines.zh: 河底太挤，翻车鱼实在让不开
lines.en: The riverbed is crowded and I can't make space.

lines.zh: 你踩起的泥糊了翻车鱼一脸
lines.en: Your step kicks up mud all over my face.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼被水流和你夹在中间
lines.en: I'm wedged between the current and you.

lines.zh: 别推，翻车鱼翻个身要半天
lines.en: Don't shove; rolling over takes me ages.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼滑开，像块被拨动的圆石
lines.en: I slide aside like a nudged round stone.

lines.zh: 撞完翻车鱼还在原地晃，晕乎乎
lines.en: After the bump I bob in place, woozy.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼找浅湾，那里适合下卵
lines.en: I search for a shallow bay, good for laying eggs.

lines.zh: 两条翻车鱼并排漂，谁也不急
lines.en: Two sunfish drift side by side, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼绕着水草转圈，算表白
lines.en: I circle the waterweed, which counts as a confession.

lines.zh: 河流这么宽，还是想找同一条
lines.en: The river is wide, yet I want the same one.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼用鳍碰碰对方，就算定了
lines.en: A brush of fins and it's settled.

lines.zh: 繁殖季的水暖，翻车鱼身子也热
lines.en: Breeding season warms the water, and me with it.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼守住浅滩，等伴侣回来
lines.en: I guard this shoal, waiting for my mate.

lines.zh: 两只圆鱼挤在一处，有点好笑
lines.en: Two round fish squeezed together look rather funny.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼答应得慢，但不会反悔
lines.en: I agree slowly, but I don't take it back.

lines.zh: 河湾的卵石下，藏着一窝希望
lines.en: Under the bend's pebbles lies a clutch of hope.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼叼起一片落叶，玩了一会儿
lines.en: I pick up a fallen leaf and play with it.

lines.zh: 河底有颗亮石子，翻车鱼收了
lines.en: A bright stone on the bed; I claim it.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼把浮萍顶在头上
lines.en: I balance duckweed on my head.

lines.zh: 掉进河里的东西，翻车鱼先捡
lines.en: Whatever falls in the river, I find first.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼含着小石子，像含着糖
lines.en: I hold a pebble like a sweet.

lines.zh: 这截树枝归我了，别捞
lines.en: This twig is mine; don't fish it out.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼捡到一枚螺壳，很得意
lines.en: I found a snail shell and I'm delighted.

lines.zh: 东西沉到泥里，翻车鱼拱出来
lines.en: It sank into mud; I root it out.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼嘴里塞满了，还在捡
lines.en: My mouth is full and I'm still collecting.

lines.zh: 捡东西比游泳容易，翻车鱼感慨
lines.en: Collecting beats swimming, I reflect.

lines.zh: 水面有动静，翻车鱼盯住了
lines.en: Something moves at the surface; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼看中那团小影子
lines.en: I've picked out that small shadow.

lines.zh: 目标在浅水，翻车鱼游过去
lines.en: The target is in the shallows; I head over.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼专心起来，比平时快一倍
lines.en: Focused, I'm twice my usual speed.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼是午饭，锁定了
lines.en: That minnow is my lunch; locked on.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼瞄准了，又忘了瞄什么
lines.en: I aim, then forget what I aimed at.

lines.zh: 河水一动，翻车鱼立刻转向
lines.en: The water stirs and I snap around.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼认定那只虾，别的都不看
lines.en: I've chosen that shrimp; nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 目标离得远，翻车鱼慢慢跟
lines.en: The target is far; I follow at ease.

lines.zh: 这一眼锁定，翻车鱼自己也没察觉
lines.en: I've locked on without noticing it myself.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼追虾，圆身子左摇右摆
lines.en: Chasing a shrimp, my round body rocks side to side.

lines.zh: 别跑，翻车鱼不会拐弯
lines.en: Don't run; I can't corner well.

lines.zh: 追到芦苇边，翻车鱼卡住了
lines.en: At the reeds I get stuck chasing.

lines.zh: 目标一躲，翻车鱼就撞上水草
lines.en: The target dodges and I hit the weeds.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼张着嘴冲，速度真不快
lines.en: Mouth open, I charge, not fast.

lines.zh: 河水推着它，也推着翻车鱼
lines.en: The current pushes the prey and me alike.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼追得很认真，尾巴都歪了
lines.en: I chase earnestly, tail askew.

lines.zh: 那只虾钻进泥里，翻车鱼在外面找
lines.en: The shrimp burrows in mud; I search outside.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼突然加速，自己都吓一跳
lines.en: I lurch forward and startle myself.

lines.zh: 追不上了，翻车鱼改成等
lines.en: Can't catch it; I switch to waiting.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼一头撞过去，软但不轻
lines.en: I ram headfirst: soft, but not light.

lines.zh: 一口含住，翻车鱼的嘴没有牙
lines.en: I gulp it down; my mouth has no teeth.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼压上去，靠体重取胜
lines.en: I press down, winning by weight.

lines.zh: 这一撞把虾弹到芦苇上
lines.en: The blow bounces the shrimp against the reeds.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼甩头，连水一起吞
lines.en: I swing my head and swallow water along with it.

lines.zh: 打得很笨，翻车鱼自己也知道
lines.en: It's a clumsy fight and I know it.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼撞完就退，怕累
lines.en: After the hit I back off, afraid of tiring.

lines.zh: 河底的泥被搅起，看不清了
lines.en: Mud clouds the riverbed and I lose sight.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼咬住不放，嘴都酸了
lines.en: I hold on until my jaw aches.

lines.zh: 疼不疼，翻车鱼嘴软你忍忍
lines.en: Does it hurt? My mouth is soft; bear with it.

lines.zh: 河面荡开一圈，翻车鱼浮上来
lines.en: A ring spreads on the river and I surface.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼出生在河湾，水正好暖
lines.en: I spawn in the river bend where the water's warm.

lines.zh: 这窝两只，翻车鱼和它的影子
lines.en: Two this spawn: me and my shadow.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼第一次顺流而下，有点慌
lines.en: My first trip downstream is a bit alarming.

lines.zh: 河水拍着卵石，翻车鱼醒了
lines.en: The river laps the pebbles and I wake.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼刚生成，身体还没摆正
lines.en: Just spawned, my body isn't upright yet.

lines.zh: 河底多了个圆影，那就是我
lines.en: A round shadow appears on the bed; that's me.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼睁开眼，先找太阳
lines.en: I open my eyes and look for the sun first.

lines.zh: 河湾的新住客，翻车鱼报到
lines.en: New resident of the bend, reporting in.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼一出生就侧着身
lines.en: I came out sideways, as usual.

lines.zh: 河水烫起来，翻车鱼直往深处钻
lines.en: The river boils and I dive for the depths.

lines.zh: 被摔到岸上，翻车鱼弹了两下
lines.en: Thrown onto the bank, I bounce twice.

lines.zh: 翻车鱼离开水，鳃干得发疼
lines.en: Out of water, my gills burn dry.

lines.zh: 冲击波推着翻车鱼撞上石头
lines.en: The blast throws me into a rock.

lines.zh: 箭扎进圆身子，翻车鱼僵住
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my round body and I freeze.

lines.zh: 药水泡得翻车鱼晕头转向
lines.en: The potion leaves me completely muddled.

lines.zh: 饿瘦了，翻车鱼都快变扁
lines.en: Starving, I've gone flat.

lines.zh: 河面炸开白光，翻车鱼翻了
lines.en: White light cracks the river and I flip over.

lines.zh: 河底裂开，翻车鱼掉了进去
lines.en: The riverbed splits and I drop through.
